CustomField.formula: (YEAR( EndDate ) - YEAR( ServiceDate ))*12 - MONTH(ServiceDate) + MONTH(EndDate) + ((DAY(EndDate) - DAY(ServiceDate) + 1) / CASE(MONTH(EndDate), 4,30, 6,30, 9,30, 11,30, 2, IF(OR( MOD( YEAR(EndDate ), 400 ) = 0, AND( MOD( YEAR(EndDate), 4 ) = 0, MOD( YEAR( EndDate), 100 ) != 0 ) ),29,28), 31) )
CustomField.label: POC Term
